projectDescription: A full-stack travel planning application that lets users build multi-city itineraries, track budgets, discover destinations and activities, and share trips publicly.
keyFeatures: Multi-city itinerary builder with drag-and-drop stop reordering
Automated budget engine with category breakdowns (Lodging, Transport, Activities, Food)
City discovery with full-text search and faceted filters (continent, cost index, popularity)
Activity catalogue with category filters and day-slot scheduling
Interactive trip calendar with monthly/weekly views and drag-to-reschedule
Public shareable itinerary URLs with one-click trip cloning
Structured itinerary view with Timeline, City Grouped, and Compact List modes
Real-time budget variance tracking with Recharts donut and bar charts
JWT/NextAuth session management with Google OAuth and demo credentials
RBAC with USER and ADMIN roles; admin analytics dashboard
Retro-futuristic (cyberpunk/vaporwave) design system with CRT scanlines and neon glow
Pre-seeded with 20+ global destinations and 80+ curated activities across 6 continents
publicApiSurface: GET /api/auth/me — Returns current authenticated user (id, email, name, role)
POST /api/auth/register — Create a new user account
GET /api/trips — List all trips for the authenticated user
GET /api/trips/:id — Get a single trip by ID
POST /api/trips/:tripId/stops — Add a city stop to a trip
POST /api/trips/:tripId/stops/:stopId/activities — Schedule an activity to a stop
GET /api/destinations/:id — Get destination details with activities
GET /api/trips/:tripId/budget — Get budget breakdown for a trip
GET /api/public/trips/:slug — Get a public trip by slug (no auth required)
POST /api/public/trips/:slug/clone — Clone a public trip to the authenticated user's account
GET /api/admin/metrics — Admin KPI metrics (ADMIN role only)
GET /api/admin/trips — Paginated trips audit table (ADMIN role only)
